answer.book: Printed Latin treatise (Frankfurt 1612) by J. H. Alsted, Trigae canonicae: a volume of three works (the mnemonic art, the Lullian art, and the art of oratory, with its appendices), each with its own parts and chapters, preceded by front matter (authors, dedications, preface) and closed by a peroration.
